purpose: Apply the prompt exclusion of a handwriting wrapper alone consistently to material counts; preserve all page text and all crop evidence.
representation_correspondence: At the explicitly listed aligned occurrences, H mathcal{U} and the final plain U refer to the same source glyph position. The reversible correspondence retains the occurrence identifier, H wrapper and final glyph spelling as separate fields. Surrounding indices, accents, bars, arrows and revision layers are held fixed or are separately recorded in the named material row. This is an accounting correspondence between recorded representations; no isomorphism between mathematical objects is asserted. On scan062 the closed upper-entry-loop forms remain mathcal U in the transcription and the open-entry forms remain U. Resolving C’s alphabet alternatives still counts against C.
evidence: All listed source glyphs were root-viewed on their saved first-pass crops. H uses mathcal U for every mathematical U in scans062–078 that contain U; earlier scans054–061 use plain U. Each listed observation retains its original C/H/final strings and crop.

The alphabet is settled locally; the decoration remains doubtful.
